value.text: {"sql": "WITH usgs_peaks AS (SELECT to_date(from_utc_timestamp(to_timestamp(hr_utc, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'), 'America/Chicago')) AS local_day, hr_utc AS usgs_peak_hr_utc, usgs_northport_peak_cfs AS usgs_peak_cfs FROM water.hourly_compare WHERE hr_utc BETWEEN '2026-10-23 00:00' AND '2026-10-25 06:00' AND usgs_northport_peak_cfs IS NOT NULL QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY to_date(from_utc_timestamp(to_timestamp(hr_utc, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'), 'America/Chicago')) ORDER BY usgs_northport_peak_cfs DESC) = 1), nwm_window AS (SELECT u.local_day, u.usgs_peak_hr_utc, u.usgs_peak_cfs, n.nwm_cfs AS nwm_at_usgs_peak_cfs, n.nwm_peak_cfs, n.nwm_peak_hour_cdt, (n.nwm_peak_hour_cdt - hour(from_utc_timestamp(to_timestamp(u.usgs_peak_hr_utc, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'), 'America/Chicago'))) AS lag_hours FROM usgs_peaks u LEFT JOIN (SELECT to_date(from_utc_timestamp(to_timestamp(hr_utc, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'), 'America/Chicago')) AS local_day, hr_utc, nwm_cfs, nwm_peak_cfs, hour(from_utc_timestamp(to_timestamp(hr_utc, 'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm'), 'America/Chicago')) AS nwm_peak_hour_cdt FROM water.hourly_compare WHERE hr_utc BETWEEN '2026-10-23 00:00' AND '2026-10-25 06:00' AND nwm_cfs IS NOT NULL) n ON u.local_day = n.local_day WHERE nwm_cfs IS NOT NULL) SELECT local_day, usgs_peak_cfs, nwm_at_usgs_peak_cfs, nwm_peak_cfs, lag_hours FROM nwm_window ORDER BY local_day LIMIT 200", "purpose": "Quantify NWM vs USGS on Oct 23–24: USGS peak cfs, NWM value at USGS peak hour, NWM peak cfs, and lag in hours"}
